profanityByLanguage.$comment: P7-07 (PUB-10): conservative per-language lists for the ten largest launch languages, applied to every chat line and name together with `profanity` (chat mixes languages). Strong insults and slurs only; words that are ordinary in another launch language or inside common words (Japanese くそ in やくそく and 死ね in 死ねない, Chinese 妈的 in 我妈的, Spanish puta = Croatian 'times', French pute = Romanian 'stinks'; English hell and dick are German words) are left out. Each list has a corpus of ordinary sentences that must pass unfiltered (tests/gameplay/sim/profanity-lists.test.ts). NOT reviewed by native speakers: docs/localization/WORD_LISTS.md. Changing a list changes the data the game and the server load: deploy them together.

groveRaid.$commentLedger: Ledger audit E12: the offline (computer) Alliance War pays its chest only to a player who attacked at least chestMinAttacks times that week, and a returning player is paid for at most the last settleWeeksMax wars (a year away used to pay 52 chests at once).

gangWar.$comment: Gang Wars (roadmap steps 65-66): 2v2 to 4v4 between Gangs of friends, a 2 h prep then a 22 h battle day, 2 attacks each; relay strikes carry damage over. Chests are fixed (scaled by Keep), nothing random, never sold. Honor never moves; the Gang Rating does (not against bots). relayCarry: the share of a relay strike's damage the next strike starts from (defenders patch up between strikes); measured in tests/gameplay/balance/gang-war.test.ts so a relay beats solo strikes by a clear but limited margin.
gangWar.$commentLedger: Ledger audit E13: a war against a generated Gang (paired after botAfterMinutes, any time of day) pays its chest in resources only; Jade comes only from wars against real Gangs.
